confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from the RBA page. Search results gave 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026, which is the latest observation I found. Food anchors come from crowdsourced cost-of-living indexes, which vary widely. Coffee and inexpensive-meal figures are better supported. Beer is a restaurant/bar draught estimate, since alcohol licensing in Essaouira is limited. Cocktail and wine are weakly supported: I found one 60 MAD house-red price and a dated USD margarita price, so I set both relative to beer and tourist-venue prices. Midrange meal for two is a bounded estimate from mixed sources. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not from live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Essaouira is a mid-priced Moroccan tourist coastal town, about 8% cheaper than the Moroccan average in the sources. I compared it with Marrakech and Agadir, scaled down slightly, with a peak-season July accommodation uplift.
